# Type of Gun

This chapter focuses time trends in the type of gun owned


**Input**

-   DemographyGunOwners/data/clean/gs-gun-owners.rds

**Output**

-   DemographyGunOwners/output

**Last ran**

-   `r format(Sys.Date(), format = "%A, %B %d, %Y")`
```{r,  message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
packages <-
  c(
    "tidyverse",
    "purrr",
    "haven",
    "survey",
    "tidyr",
    "gtsummary",
    "janitor",
    "dplyr",
    "here",
    "vtable",
    "paletteer",
    "fastDummies"
  )

pacman::p_load(
  packages,
  character.only = TRUE
)
```

## Import data

```{r}
gun <-
  read_rds(
     here(
      path_od, 
      "data",
      "clean",
      "gs-gun-owners.rds"
      )
  )
```


## Estimates with CIs

```{r}
walk(
  select(gun, starts_with("own")) %>% names(),
  ~  print(gun %>% tabyl(.x))
)
```
